versions.description_html:
Learn architecture patterns for OT IT convergence on Azure. Connect PLCs safely without breaking production or exposing your plant to operational risks.

Connecting PLCs to IT systems adds value and risk if production is not protected. In this episode of the iFAKT series, we discuss architecture patterns for OT-IT convergence on Azure, with safe boundaries and data flows.
You will learn how to connect equipment without breaking production.
Who it is for: OT engineers, IT architects and plant managers.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Why Your Production Schedule Is Wrong Before It Even Starts
  • Production Planning Software: When Does a Manufacturer Actually Need It?
  • More Cloud Architecture episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Azure & Cloud: the most-listened episodes
